1.web: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
1.asv: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus that are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

2.web: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2.asv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.web: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
3.asv: I thank my God upon all my remembrance of you,

4.web: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all making my requests with joy,
4.asv: always in every supplication of mine on behalf of you all making my supplication with joy,

5.web: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
5.asv: for your fellowship in furtherance of the gospel from the first day until now;

6.web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
6.asv: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:

7.web: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
7.asv: even as it is right for me to be thus minded on behalf of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as, both in my bonds and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers with me of grace.

8.web: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
8.asv: For God is my witness, how I long after you all in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

9.web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;
9.asv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

10.web: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;
10.asv: so that ye may approve the things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and void of offence unto the day of Christ;

11.web: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
11.asv: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

12.web: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;
12.asv: Now I would have you know, brethren, that the thingswhich happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the progress of the gospel;

13.web: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;
13.asv: so that my bonds became manifest in Christ throughout the whole prætorian guard, and to all the rest;

14.web: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
14.asv: and that most of the brethren in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

15.web: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
15.asv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

16.web: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
16.asv: the one do it of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel;

17.web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
17.asv: but the other proclaim Christ of faction, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.

18.web: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
18.asv: What then? only that in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and therein I rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

19.web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
19.asv: For I know that this shall turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

20.web: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
20.asv: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing shall I be put to shame, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

21.web: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
21.asv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

22.web: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
22.asv: But if to live in the flesh,—if this shall bring fruit from my work, then what I shall choose I know not.

23.web: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
23.asv: But I am in a strait betwixt the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ; for it is very far better:

24.web: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
24.asv: yet to abide in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

25.web: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,
25.asv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide, yea, and abide with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith;

26.web: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
26.asv: that your glorying may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

27.web: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
27.asv: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ: that, whether I come and see you or be absent, I may hear of your state, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the gospel;

28.web: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
28.asv: and in nothing affrighted by the adversaries: which is for them an evident token of perdition, but of your salvation, and that from God;

29.web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
29.asv: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:

30.web: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.
30.asv: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
